subject.title: security(audit): warn on plugin load paths and SecretRef env fallback

question: After default no-exec behavior is restored, should OpenClaw adopt the proposed plugin load-path and SecretRef fallback check IDs, severities, scope, and remediation?
rationale: Source inspection can establish the execution defect, but the resulting warnings define operator trust and credential-remediation policy that requires security-owner intent.

options.title: Repair then approve
options.body: Restore explicit exec gating, add entry-point regression tests, and approve the warning contract after security-area review.

options.title: Split the change
options.body: Land the independently safe plugin load-path diagnostics and redesign SecretRef fallback detection in narrower follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Repair then approve
recommendation.body: Restore explicit exec gating, add entry-point regression tests, and approve the warning contract after security-area review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history provides the strongest ownership signal for the secrets runtime and audit contracts involved in this decision.
